title: Founder Command Deck & Platform Fleet Directives
description: Executive command center for the platform founder to triage strategic priorities offline and monitor fleet-wide institution health, classroom vitality, and active souls.

intents.title: Triage Strategic Founder Priorities
intents.outcome: Capture, reorder, and complete platform directives with instant offline-first reactivity.

journeys.title: Manage Founder Command Deck Directives
journeys.situation: The platform founder opens the executive workspace on mobile or web and needs to capture, prioritize, and complete operational tasks with zero network delay.
journeys.outcome: Directives are instantly committed to local SQLite and replicated to Supabase.
preconditions: Authenticated account has founder or developer capacity.

existingBehavior: Founder dashboard mounts at /workspace/founder with access restricted to founder/developer/admin bonds.
Embedded TodoView powers instant optimistic mutations against local SQLite.
invariants: Tasks written on device must never be lost during network drops or background sync pauses.
UI must never drop frames during gesture interaction; all swipe animations execute on the native UI thread.
Personal priorities remain strictly isolated to the authenticated canonical account identity.
openQuestions: Should directives support cross-organization assignment to specific school principals?

steps.title: Open Founder Cockpit
steps.interaction: Navigate to the workspace tab and select Founder Command Deck.

steps.title: Add Strategic Directive
steps.interaction: Type priority in the quick-add input and press submit.

steps.title: Execute Swipe Action
steps.interaction: Swipe right to mark complete with haptic tick, or left to delete.

steps.title: Directives Settled
steps.interaction: List updates smoothly via spring physics and syncs in background.

transitions.title: Focus add input
transitions.feedback: Display keyboard and input border highlight.

transitions.title: Swipe task row
transitions.action: Pan horizontally across a directive row.
transitions.feedback: Render under-layer action badge with spring physics.

requirements.title: Instant Offline Mutations
requirements.statement: Founder tasks must write directly to local SQLite without waiting for server response.

requirements.title: 60fps Swipe Ergonomics
requirements.statement: Row swiping must run on the native worklet thread via Gesture.Pan.

bindings.title: Mobile Founder Route
bindings.note: Mounts executive dashboard behind capacity gate.

bindings.title: PowerSync Todos Hook
bindings.note: Local SQLite reactive query via useLiveQuery.

scenarios.title: Quick Capture and Complete Directive
scenarios.expected: Task is added and marked complete in <16ms with zero dropped frames.

intents.title: Monitor Platform Fleet Pulse & Institution Health
intents.outcome: Observe holistic ecosystem telemetry and navigate to school governance.

journeys.title: Audit Fleet Telemetry & Institutions
journeys.situation: The founder needs an immediate high-level summary of total schools, active souls, classrooms, and health percentage across the entire ecosystem.
journeys.outcome: Live pulse metrics are displayed with deep links to school management.
preconditions: Authenticated account has platform administrative authority.

existingBehavior: useFounderEcosystemStats fetches schools and global platform metrics.
invariants: Metrics gracefully fall back to cache when offline without blank screens.
Navigation to specific schools preserves active breadcrumbs.
openQuestions: Should telemetry support time-series delta comparisons (e.g. 7d vs 30d)?

steps.title: Review Ecosystem Pulse
steps.interaction: Inspect top-level stat cards (schools, souls, classrooms, teachers).

steps.title: Select Institution
steps.interaction: Tap a school card in the Institutions roster.

transitions.title: Navigate to school
transitions.action: Tap on a school item in the institutions gallery.

requirements.title: Accurate Fleet Telemetry
requirements.statement: Ecosystem health and entity counts must be computed from verified database aggregates.

bindings.title: Founder Workspace Bridge
bindings.note: Aggregates school entities and fleet counts.

scenarios.title: Inspect School Fleet Metrics
scenarios.expected: Health badge and school cards render with real database counts.

intents.title: Collaborate with Sovereign AI Mentor
intents.outcome: Converse with persistent AI mentor agent for strategic planning, queries, and background tasks.

journeys.title: Consult Platform AI Mentor
journeys.situation: The founder needs strategic consultation, policy drafting, or telemetry summaries via conversational AI.
journeys.outcome: Opens a persistent thread with Tutii/AI mentor with shared founder context.

existingBehavior: AIAssistantRouteContent mounts persistent AI Assistant interface at /a-i-assistant.
invariants: Mentor conversations must preserve user context and thread identity across launches.
Sensitive multi-tenant identifiers are scrubbed before inference.
openQuestions: Can AI mentor directly execute founder transactional actions on approval?

steps.title: Launch AI Mentor
steps.interaction: Click AI Assistant card from the Founder overview.

steps.title: Engage in Dialogue
steps.interaction: Prompt the assistant for strategic actions or summaries.

requirements.title: Thread Persistence
requirements.statement: Conversations must maintain local context and thread continuity.

scenarios.title: Open AI Mentor Dialogue
scenarios.expected: AI assistant opens with persistent threadId ready for conversation.

intents.title: Charter School & Provision Community
intents.outcome: Provision a new educational sanctuary and automatically generate principal onboarding tokens.

journeys.title: Charter New Sanctuary School
journeys.situation: A new educational institution is onboarded into the Gurudevi network.
journeys.outcome: School row is inserted, initial community group created, and claim token issued.

existingBehavior: CreateSchoolModal provides full multistep form for school demographics.
GlobalCreateModal enables quick-provisioning of schools and classrooms.
invariants: Chartering a school must generate unique claim code for the founding principal.
School handle and census ID must be unique across the federation.
openQuestions: Should schools default to Sri Lankan national curriculum or custom?

steps.title: Open School Chartering
steps.interaction: Click 'Charter Institution' in the Founder Cockpit.

steps.title: Complete Provisioning
steps.interaction: Fill institution name, type, and province to create.

transitions.title: Submit charter form
transitions.feedback: School record created and modal dismissed.

requirements.title: Atomic Provisioning
requirements.statement: School entity creation must initialize associated metadata and invite codes.

scenarios.title: Provision New School Entity
scenarios.expected: School created and displayed in Institutions gallery.

intents.title: Triage Inbound Support & Broadcast Announcements
intents.outcome: Review school echo feedback, support requests, and dispatch transactional broadcasts.

journeys.title: Triage Feedback & Ecosystem Broadcast
journeys.situation: Founder checks inbound institutional feedback and needs to notify schools of platform updates.
journeys.outcome: Inbound tickets reviewed and high-priority notices dispatched via Postgres RLS.

existingBehavior: DashboardEcho fetches unread feedback from school_echo_feedback.
Platform broadcast table created with sovereign RLS.
invariants: Only sovereign stewards may create global platform broadcasts.
Support items marked as read sync across admin sessions.

steps.title: View Support & Feedback
steps.interaction: Inspect aggregated school echo feedback and incoming inquiries.

requirements.title: Broadcast RLS Security
requirements.statement: Broadcast insertion restricted strictly to sovereign platform stewards.

scenarios.title: Dispatch National Circular
scenarios.expected: Broadcast record inserted and active toast displayed.
